subject: Re: Aligning tomorrow's product demo — need to retime
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@finovahealth.com>, David Li <david.li@finovahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Product demo — availability for tomorrow?

Hi Samira / David,

Thanks again for the rapid interest — excited to show a focused 30–40 minute demo of Redwood Inference tailored to your cost-and-latency questions. We have a slot open tomorrow; can you confirm which of these works for your exec and technical attendees?

• 09:30–10:10 PT
• 11:00–11:40 PT
• 14:00–14:40 PT

Monica (SE) will lead the technical walkthrough; Karthik (AE) will cover pricing and next steps. Attaching the deck we’ll use so you can flag any specific slides to skip/add.

If none of these work, happy to move to Friday or next week — what’s highest priority for your exec team?

Best,
Michael Grant
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-deck-redwood-v2.pdf (18 pages, slides)
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@finovahealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Li <david.li@finovahealth.com>, procurement@finovahealth.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Product demo — availability for tomorrow?

Thanks Michael — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Unfortunately our CEO’s calendar just filled with a run-through for a board meeting tomorrow morning, so the 09:30 and 11:00 PT windows are now tight. The 14:00 slot could work but it coincides with a vendor call our CTO needs to attend.

Do you have anything later in the day (after 15:30 PT) or early next week? Ideally we’d keep the executive portion to the first 15 minutes, then the technical deep-dive with Monica and the team.

If it helps, Monday July 28 looks wide open on our side between 10:00–13:00 PT. Procurement is also looping to understand contracting timelines — they can join whichever time we lock.

Apologies for the scramble — can you propose 2 options and we’ll confirm?

—Samira
Samira Khan
SVP, Product & Growth
Finova Health
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@finovahealth.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Product demo — availability for tomorrow?

> Thanks Michael — appreciate the quick turnaround.
> 
> Unfortunately our CEO’s calendar just filled ...
> 
> If it helps, Monday July 28 looks wide open on our side between 10:00–13:00 PT.

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up. Quick note on my side: I’m traveling and in transit the afternoon of Jul 23 and out of timezone for most of the day (on calls with a partner). I can do tomorrow morning until 12:30 PT, or Monday July 28 as you suggested. I also have a short window on Wed Jul 23 at 10:00–10:45 PT if that’s preferable for a compact demo.

If you need the executive 15-minute summary earlier, Karthik can do the high-level portion and I can join for the deep dive later in the session. Happy to be flexible — I want to make sure we show the right benchmarks and the KV-cache example that answers your CTO’s throughput question.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: calendar-invite.ics (proposed 10:00–10:45 PT placeholder)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@finovahealth.com>, David Li <david.li@finovahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Product demo — availability for tomorrow?

Thanks all — appreciate the quick replies and flexibility.

To summarize options and pick one that minimizes churn:

1) Keep it tomorrow morning at 10:00–10:45 PT (Monica leads technical demo; exec summary first 15 min). Monica has a short block and will join in person before travel.
2) Move to Monday July 28, 10:30–11:15 PT (full team available; procurement can join).
3) If you prefer exec-first tomorrow and a deeper technical follow-up, Karthik can run the 15-minute executive session tomorrow at 15:45 PT and Monica will schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive next week.

Samira — which of the three would you prefer? If option 1 works we’ll lock 10:00 PT tomorrow and Lauren will send the invite and attach the deck. If not, we’ll book option 2.

Lauren — can you please hold 10:00–10:45 PT on the Redwood-demo calendar for Michael/Monica/Karthik until Samira confirms? Also attach the latest deck (demo-deck-redwood-v2.pdf) to the invite.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
